_about: Hand-maintained config for scripts/load_service_catalog.py (Handoff 55 §1/§2). The Aspire extract is scripts/data/aspire_install_service_catalog.json; this file holds only the decisions the extract cannot make.

seeded_sections._note: Section keys from the extract's recommended_sections, seeded as install service_categories in this display order. 'design' is left out on purpose until product decides whether it is a level-1 install section.

optional_section._note: Not an Aspire ServiceType: one extra install category, is_optional = 1, whose raw Aspire group name the extract verified (answer q3). It owns no services.
optional_section.name: Optional Services

item_class_codes._note: Handoff 55 section -> item-class mapping as item_classes.code values (scripts/data/acumatica_item_classes.xlsx), the materials-search soft prefilter. Filter on the code, never on the padded underscore id. A section not listed here = NULL = unfiltered. landscape: 701 Aggregate, 702 Soil, 704 Mulch, 705 Geotextile, 706 Planters, 708 Hardscape/Pavers, 709 Lumber + 80x LG (Trees, Palms, Shrubs/Vines, Bamboo, Annuals, Small Materials). 807 LG-Subcontractor Labor is Subcontractor's.

required_services._note: The five main install services, by Aspire service id. The load fails if the extract stops producing any of them.
